create_data_init: create a data pipeline by calling init with category index, resolution, and batch size parameters
run_train_dataloader: run the train function to build a DataLoader with augmented 3D point cloud data for training
run_valid_dataloader: run the valid function to build a DataLoader with augmented 3D point cloud data for validation
load_point_cloud_data: load point cloud coordinates and segmentation labels from .pts and .seg files
merge_batch_samples: merge multiple point cloud samples into a batch with random rotation and translation augmentation
